run_actionengine_server: run the actionengine websocket server with qwen model for the complimenter example
setup_action_engine_settings: configure actionengine global settings to enable automatic deserialization and ordered reading
create_action_registry_service: create an action registry and wrap it in an actionengine service with websocket server

configure_webrtc_signalling: configure the webrtc signalling server host port and identity for the actionengine server
